name: Sluce
tagline: The operating system for industrial sanitation at scale.
positioning: Sluce gives enterprise facilities teams verifiable proof that every clean-in-place cycle, wash bay, and sanitation shift met spec — auditable to the minute.

hero.h1: Prove every clean. Down to the cycle.
hero.sub: Sluce turns sanitation from a clipboard liability into a live, defensible record — CIP loops, chemical dosing, and crew verification unified across every facility you run.

features.title: Verified clean-in-place cycles
features.description: Sensor-tied logs capture temperature, flow, and dwell time for every CIP loop, then flag any cycle that drifts from your sanitation SOP before the line restarts.

features.title: Chemical dosing ledger
features.description: Track concentration, lot, and consumption per wash bay so procurement, EHS, and auditors read from a single source of truth instead of reconciled spreadsheets.

features.title: Shift verification
features.description: Crews sign off zones on a mobile console; supervisors approve exceptions. Every signature is timestamped, geo-stamped, and locked to the work order.

features.title: Audit-ready exports
features.description: Generate FDA, USDA, or ISO 22000 evidence packets for any date range in seconds — no more reassembling paper logs the night before an inspection.

features.title: Downtime intelligence
features.description: See sanitation time as a cost center. Sluce quantifies changeover minutes per line and surfaces where cleaning throughput is throttling production.

features.title: Multi-site rollups
features.description: Standardize SOPs across plants, then benchmark compliance rate, rework, and consumption facility by facility from one executive dashboard.

testimonials.quote: Before Sluce our sanitation records lived in three binders and two email threads. Our last audit closed in a single afternoon because every CIP cycle was already documented and defensible.
testimonials.name: Marissa Kohl

testimonials.quote: We cut sanitation-driven changeover time by 19% in two quarters. Sluce showed us exactly which lines were over-cleaning and which crews needed retraining.
testimonials.name: Devin Aramburu

testimonials.quote: The chemical dosing ledger alone paid for itself. We caught a mis-calibrated dispenser wasting concentrate across four wash bays within the first month.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman
